lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ghar 3 asatapadeeaa ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl, Third House, Ashtpadheeyaa:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੇ ਦੁਲਭ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਬ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh bhramate bhramate dulabh janam ab paaio ||1||
lines.translation: Wandering and roaming through 8.4 million incarnations, you have now been given this human life, so difficult to obtain. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮੂੜੇ ਤੂ ਹੋਛੈ ਰਸਿ ਲਪਟਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: re mooRe too hochhai ras lapataaio ||
lines.translation: You fool! You are attached and clinging to such trivial pleasures!

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸਤੁ ਹੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸਿਉ ਉਰਝਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit sa(n)g basat hai terai bikhiaa siu urajhaaio ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Ambrosial Nectar abides with you, but you are engrossed in sin and corruption. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਬਨਜਨਿ ਆਇਓ ਕਾਲਰੁ ਲਾਦਿ ਚਲਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ratan javehar banajan aaio kaalar laad chalaaio ||2||
lines.translation: You have come to trade in gems and jewels, but you have loaded only barren soil. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਰਹਨਾ ਬਸਨਾ ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jih ghar mahi tudh rahanaa basanaa so ghar cheet na aaio ||3||
lines.translation: That home within which you live - you have not kept that home in your thoughts. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਟਲ ਅਖੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਹੀ ਤੁਝੁ ਗਾਇਓ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: atal akha(n)d praan sukhadaaee ik nimakh nahee tujh gaaio ||4||
lines.translation: He is immovable, indestructible, the Giver of peace to the soul; and yet you do not sing His Praises, even for an instant. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹਾ ਜਾਣਾ ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਓ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਇਓ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: jahaa jaanaa so thaan visaario ik nimakh nahee man laaio ||5||
lines.translation: You have forgotten that place where you must go; you have not attached your mind to the Lord, even for an instant. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਇਸ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਉਰਝਾਇਓ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: putr kalatr grih dekh samagree is hee mahi urajhaaio ||6||
lines.translation: Gazing upon your children, spouse, household and paraphernalia, you are entangled in them. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਇਓ ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ ਤੈਸੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਓ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: jit ko laaio tit hee laagaa taise karam kamaaio ||7||
lines.translation: As God links the mortals, so are they linked, and so are the deeds they do. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਤਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਓ ॥੮॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jau bhaio kripaal taa saadhasa(n)g paaiaa jan naanak braham dhiaaio ||8||1||
lines.translation: When He becomes Merciful, then the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is found; servant Nanak meditates on God. ||8||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਨੋ ਭਇਓ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar anugrahu raakh leeno bhaio saadhoo sa(n)g ||
lines.translation: Granting His Grace, He has protected me; I have found the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਉਚਾਰੈ ਮਿਸਟ ਗੂੜਾ ਰੰਗੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har naam ras rasanaa uchaarai misat gooRaa ra(n)g ||1||
lines.translation: My tongue lovingly chants the Lord's Name; this love is so sweet and intense! ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਾਨ ਕੋ ਅਸਥਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere maan ko asathaan ||
lines.translation: He is the place of rest for my mind,

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੀਤ ਸਾਜਨ ਸਖਾ ਬੰਧਪੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: meet saajan sakhaa ba(n)dhap a(n)tarajaamee jaan ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: my friend, companion, associate and relative; He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਇਓ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਗਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)saar saagar jin upaaio saran prabh kee gahee ||
lines.translation: He created the world-ocean; I seek the Sanctuary of that God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਰਾਧੇ ਜਮਕੰਕਰੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਕਹੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gur prasaadee prabh araadhe jamaka(n)kar kichh na kahee ||2||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, I worship and adore God; the Messenger of Death can't say anything to me. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਤ ਰਿਦਾ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: mokh mukat duaar jaa kai sa(n)t ridaa bha(n)daar ||
lines.translation: Emancipation and liberation are at His Door; He is the treasure in the hearts of the Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਦਾ ਰਾਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jee jugat sujaan suaamee sadaa raakhanahaar ||3||
lines.translation: The all-knowing Lord and Master shows us the true way of life; He is our Savior and Protector forever. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਕਲੇਸ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: dookh darad kales binasahi jis basai man maahi ||
lines.translation: Pain, suffering and troubles are eradicated, when the Lord abides in the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਰਤੁ ਨਰਕੁ ਅਸਥਾਨ ਬਿਖੜੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਨ ਪੋਹੈ ਤਾਹਿ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: mirat narak asathaan bikhaRe bikh na pohai taahi ||4||
lines.translation: Death, hell and the most horrible dwelling of sin and corruption cannot even touch such a person. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਾ ਪਰਵਾਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: ridh sidh nav nidh jaa kai a(n)mritaa paravaah ||
lines.translation: Wealth, miraculous spiritual powers and the nine treasures come from the Lord, as do the streams of Ambrosial Nectar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤੇ ਮਧਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਊਚ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਹ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: aad a(n)te madh pooran ooch agam agaah ||5||
lines.translation: In the beginning, in the middle, and in the end, He is perfect, lofty, unapproachable and unfathomable. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਦੇਵ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਬੇਦ ਕਰਹਿ ਉਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sidh saadhik dev mun jan bed karahi uchaar ||
lines.translation: The Siddhas, seekers, angelic beings, silent sages, and the Vedas speak of Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਿ ਭੁੰਚਹਿ ਨਹੀ ਅੰਤੁ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: simar suaamee sukh sahaj bhu(n)chahi nahee a(n)t paaraavaar ||6||
lines.translation: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord and Master, celestial peace is enjoyed; He has no end or limitation. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਛਤ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਜਪਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: anik praachhat mitahi khin mahi ridai jap bhagavaan ||
lines.translation: Countless sins are erased in an instant, meditating on the Benevolent Lord within the heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਵਨਾ ਤੇ ਮਹਾ ਪਾਵਨ ਕੋਟਿ ਦਾਨ ਇਸਨਾਨ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: paavanaa te mahaa paavan kot daan isanaan ||7||
lines.translation: Such a person becomes the purest of the pure, and is blessed with the merits of millions of donations to charity and cleansing baths. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਸੁਧਿ ਪਰਾਣ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਸੰਤਨਾ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: bal budh sudh paraan sarabas sa(n)tanaa kee raas ||
lines.translation: God is power, intellect, understanding, the breath of life, wealth, and everything for the Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਿਮਖ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੮॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: bisar naahee nimakh man te naanak kee aradaas ||8||2||
lines.translation: May I never forget Him from my mind, even for an instant - this is Nanak's prayer. ||8||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਸਤ੍ਰਿ ਤੀਖਣਿ ਕਾਟਿ ਡਾਰਿਓ ਮਨਿ ਨ ਕੀਨੋ ਰੋਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sasatr teekhan kaat daario man na keeno ros ||
lines.translation: The sharp tool cuts down the tree, but it does not feel anger in its mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਜੁ ਉਆ ਕੋ ਲੇ ਸਵਾਰਿਓ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਦੀਨੋ ਦੋਸੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kaaj uaa ko le savaario til na deeno dos ||1||
lines.translation: It serves the purpose of the cutter, and does not blame him at all. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਉ ਨਿਤ ਨੀਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: man mere raam rau nit neet ||
lines.translation: O my mind, continually, continuously, meditate on the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਇਆਲ ਦੇਵ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸੁਨਿ ਸੰਤਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: daiaal dev kripaal gobi(n)d sun sa(n)tanaa kee reet ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Lord of the Universe is merciful, divine and compassionate. Listen - this is the way of the Saints. ||1||Pause||
